_note: v2 hook overrides for le palais des glaces (B52_miroirs). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting shows them; these replace only hooks that cannot be painted (nothing may be written) or that differ from what is painted.

fr_fondamental_adj.hook: Like English 'fundamental', said fohn-dah-mahn-TAHL: the FUNDAMENTAL rule of the hall of mirrors, drawn up TALL on the booth's chalkboard: a laughing face crossed out, because no one may laugh at their own reflection.
fr_fondamental_adj.why: Nothing may be written in the paintings, so the rule is drawn as a crossed-out laughing face instead of chalked words.

fr_serre_adj.hook: A TIGHT belt squeezes a round gentleman's middle as he measures himself with a tape: "Sir, eh?" ("seh-RAY") he gasps.
fr_serre_adj.why: No tailor is painted; the gentleman with the tape measure gasps the line himself.

fr_gigantesque_adj.hook: Like English 'gigantic', said zhee-gahn-TEHSK: a GIGANTIC hamster squeezes up to a doll's DESK, far too big for it, beside a tiny doll.
fr_gigantesque_adj.why: The painting shows the hamster towering over the doll's desk rather than flattening it.

fr_tenace_adj.hook: Like English 'tenacious', said tuh-NAHS: a TENACIOUS terrier holds onto a knotted rope toy so firmly that nothing will make him let go.
fr_tenace_adj.why: The painted terrier grips the rope with his paws on the shelf; he is not lifted off the floor.

fr_contraignant_adj.hook: A train ("kon-TRAIN-yahn") squeezed onto RESTRICTIVE narrow tracks that curl tight around it like a corset, unable to wiggle.
fr_contraignant_adj.why: The toy train is painted on narrow curling tracks, without a laced corset.

fr_tendu_adj.hook: A TAUT tightrope; the tense acrobat steps on it tenderly ("tahn-DEW").
fr_tendu_adj.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ton-DU -> tahn-DEW).

fr_epais_adj.hook: A THICK slice of cake so tall you have to pay ("ay-PEH") extra for it.
fr_epais_adj.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-PAY -> ay-PEH).
